steps.body: PLACEHOLDER: this chapter is still being written, and Snake ToolBox is not going to pretend otherwise. This is Pillar 3, a marquee module. Here you will handle large or infinite data streams lazily (the iterator protocol, generators and yield, generator expressions, pipelines, and itertools). A quick note to keep two ideas apart: these yield-based generators are the language feature, not the same thing as the automation scripts you want to build. Its boss is build-it-yourself: your own iterable plus a generator pipeline. The full version is on the way. For now this page is an honest signpost of where the road goes next, not the lesson itself.
